// Import is inactive. Keep live_enabled false until the live checklist is completed.
return [{json:{
  mode: 'draft',
  live_enabled: false,
  campaign_day: 1,
  launch_date: null, // UTC YYYY-MM-DD; when set, campaign day follows elapsed calendar days.
  selected_locales: ['ru','en'],
  selected_variants: ['a','b'],
  selected_channels: ['tiktok','youtube_shorts'],
  approved_campaign_ids: [],
  approved_channels: [],
  final_asset_urls: {}, // campaign ID -> owned/licensed, public HTTPS video URL
  adapter_url: '', // Your verified HTTPS adapter; intentionally no fabricated endpoint.
  adapter_authorization_configured: false
}}];
return $input.all().map(i => ({json:{...i.json, publication_status:'not_sent', review_instructions:'Review this draft. No video has been rendered, uploaded, or published.'}}));

return $input.all().map(item => ({json:{kind:'adapter_response',received_at:new Date().toISOString(),adapter_response:item.json,note:'An HTTP response is not proof of publication. Use the adapter status and platform ID/URL; record only verified outcomes.'}}));

parameters.content:
## Safe default
Imported inactive. Manual execution fetches the owned campaign feed and produces drafts. Nothing is uploaded or published.

To connect live: follow marketing/PLAYBOOK.md; configure your real adapter, HTTP Header Auth credential, explicit channel and campaign approvals, final video assets, and mode=live.

Set launch_date before enabling the daily schedule. TikTok/YouTube integrations require their own approved APIs and account tokens.
